cohort: A population-based cohort included 72,160 live births in Matlab, Bangladesh from 1990 to 2019; analysis of recurrence risk included 14,567 women with live-born singletons in their first and second pregnancies.
finding: The proportion of preterm births decreased from 25% in 1990 to 13% in 2019, with a similar decrease in recurrent preterm births (7.4% to 3.1%), but women with a prior preterm birth had double the odds of preterm birth in their second pregnancy (OR 2.18; 95% CI 1.96 to 2.43).
followup_time: Time between first and second pregnancies (exact time not specified).
